notes: Seychelles Nation reported that the ISCEICT's state-of-the-art data centre, IT centre and virtual reality lab would have its main centre at Mont-Fleuri, with community information centres on Praslin and La Digue. The current UniSey computing programme page confirms the Mont Fleuri campus context, but no later public source found with capacity or current facility specifications.
